title: cacalia articularis
intro: Cacalia articularis, commonly known as Artichoke, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family. The health benefits of Cacalia articularis include its ability to support liver health, aid in digestion, and help lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its choleretic properties, which stimulate the production of bile, and its hepatoprotective effects, which protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia articularis include caffeic acid, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
